Common Questions

Everything You Need to Know

How much does gorilla trekking in Uganda cost?

Uganda Wildlife Authority gorilla permits cost $800 USD per person. Our 3-day Bwindi package starts from $1,450 USD per person — including permit, expert guide, park fees and lodge accommodation near the forest.

What is the best time to visit Uganda for a safari?

Uganda can be visited year-round. Best dry seasons are June–August and December–February. Gorilla trekking is possible any month. The wet seasons offer lush landscapes with fewer crowds.

Do you arrange airport transfers from Entebbe?

Yes. We provide airport pick-ups and drop-offs from Entebbe International Airport in our modern safari vans. Our driver will meet you at arrivals with a name board, any hour of the day.

Can I customise my Uganda safari itinerary?

Absolutely — every package is fully customisable. We build itineraries around your interests, budget, travel dates and group size. Contact us on WhatsApp for a personalised quote.

What vehicles do you use?

We use custom-built Toyota safari vans with roof racks, pop-up roofs, leather seating, USB charging ports, cooler boxes and air conditioning — purpose-built for Uganda's terrain and game viewing.

Do you handle cross-border travel to Rwanda or Kenya?

Yes. We arrange combined Uganda–Rwanda gorilla safaris and cross-border journeys to Kenya and Tanzania, handling all logistics, visa guidance, transport and accommodation throughout.
